questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Course opportunities, I wanted to be a place where the courses where interesting and I wanted to see a different culture but still be inside of Europe

Additional comments:

questions.answer: very easy, only difficulty was to know if I was qualified for the specific course

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Very easy, I was contacted by the organisation Erasmus life nicosia who help with finding accommodation, and I had no problem renting threw them

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: campus is pretty far from city center but a lot of the social events are in city center so I recommend living in city center since public transport to university was good

questions.answer: the mobility office

questions.answer: no problems

questions.answer: class room teaching with attendance and assignments

questions.answer: 1 semester

entrepreneurship, Labour economics
great courses that where relevant  for everyone even though everyone has different backgrounds
